scenes.vo: Một sàn thẻ bài vừa kiếm được một tỷ đô, và người bán trên đó ăn mừng bằng cách nhờ chính phủ điều tra nó.
scenes.gloss: A card marketplace just made a billion dollars, and its sellers celebrate by asking the government to investigate it.
scenes.viewer: Big money upstairs; down here a seller 'celebrates' with an investigation request.

scenes.vo: Sàn đó là TCGplayer, chợ mua bán thẻ Magic và Pokémon, con cưng của eBay.
scenes.gloss: That marketplace is TCGplayer, the market for Magic and Pokémon cards, eBay's darling.
scenes.viewer: What TCGplayer is: a big online card market, owned by eBay.

scenes.gloss: In May last year the authentication center in Syracuse closed, and more than two hundred unionized workers lost their jobs.
scenes.viewer: A grading center shuts; the workers walk out with their boxes.

scenes.gloss: You see, just imagine a market. The management charges your stall fee, bans you from bringing your own scale, then builds an identical stall right next to yours, selling exactly what you sell.
scenes.viewer: Fee, banned scale, a copycat stall right beside his.
